import os
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import MessageTextInput, Output, SecretStrInput, DropdownInput
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from langchain_groq import ChatGroq
from pydantic.v1 import SecretStr

class NicheFinderAgent(Component):
    display_name: str = "HT 2: Niche Finder Agent"
    description: str = "Identifies high-demand business niches using Groq AI."
    name = "NicheFinderAgent"
    icon = "Target"

    inputs = [
        SecretStrInput(name="groq_api_key", display_name="Groq API Key", required=True),
        DropdownInput(name="model_name", display_name="Model", options=["llama-3.3-70b-versatile", "llama-3.1-8b-instant", "mixtral-8x7b-32768"], value="llama-3.3-70b-versatile"),
        MessageTextInput(name="market_context", display_name="Market Context", info="Current market or general focus (e.g., Uttar Pradesh, Small Businesses).", value="General Indian Market"),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Niche Suggestions", name="niche_output", method="find_niche")]

    def find_niche(self) -> Message:
        api_key = self.groq_api_key or os.getenv("GROQ_API_KEY")
        llm = ChatGroq(api_key=SecretStr(api_key).get_secret_value(), model=self.model_name)
        prompt = (f"As a business growth expert for Harxit Tech, analyze the {self.market_context} market. "
                  "Identify 5 high-demand business niches that need digital transformation (Websites, SEO, CRM, Apps). "
                  "For each niche, explain WHY it is hot right now and what service Harxit Tech should pitch. "
                  "Provide the response in a structured list format.")
        response = llm.invoke(prompt)
        return Message(text=response.content)

import os
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import MessageTextInput, Output, SecretStrInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data

class LeadScraperAgent(Component):
    display_name: str = "HT 1: Lead Scraper Agent"
    description: str = "Extracts business leads (Name, Phone, Email) using ScrapeGraph search."
    name = "LeadScraperAgent"
    icon = "Search"

    inputs = [
        SecretStrInput(name="api_key", display_name="ScrapeGraph API Key", required=True, password=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="location", display_name="Location", info="Target city or area (e.g., Agra, Delhi)."),
        MessageTextInput(name="business_type", display_name="Business Type", info="Type of business (e.g., School, Hospital, Gym)."),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Leads Data", name="leads", method="scrape_leads")]

    def scrape_leads(self) -> Data:
        try:
            from scrapegraph_py import Client
        except ImportError as e:
            raise ImportError("Could not import scrapegraph-py package. Please install it with `pip install scrapegraph-py`.") from e
        search_prompt = (f"Find contact details (Business Name, Phone Number, Email, Website, FULL ADDRESS) "
                         f"for {self.business_type} strictly located in {self.location}. "
                         f"DO NOT return businesses from other cities or states. "
                         f"Return as a list of JSON objects.")
        api_key = self.api_key or os.getenv("SCRAPEGRAPH_API_KEY")
        sgai_client = Client(api_key=api_key)
        try:
            response = sgai_client.searchscraper(user_prompt=search_prompt)
            sgai_client.close()
            return Data(data=response)
        except Exception:
            sgai_client.close()
            raise

import os
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import MessageTextInput, Output, SecretStrInput
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from langchain_groq import ChatGroq
from pydantic.v1 import SecretStr

class SmartLeadScoringAgent(Component):
    display_name: str = "HT 4: Smart Lead Scoring Agent"
    description: str = "De-duplicates and categorizes leads as Hot, Warm, or Cold based on business data."
    name = "SmartLeadScoringAgent"
    icon = "Activity"

    inputs = [
        SecretStrInput(name="groq_api_key", display_name="Groq API Key", required=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="consolidated_leads", display_name="Consolidated Leads", info="Combined lead data from Google, Maps, and DuckDuckGo."),
        MessageTextInput(name="location", display_name="Target Location", info="The city we are targeting (e.g., Agra).", value="Agra"),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Final Lead Report", name="output", method="score_leads")]

    def score_leads(self) -> Message:
        api_key = self.groq_api_key or os.getenv("GROQ_API_KEY")
        llm = ChatGroq(api_key=SecretStr(api_key).get_secret_value(), model="llama-3.3-70b-versatile")
        
        prompt = (f"As a Business Analyst for Harxit Tech, process this raw lead list: {self.consolidated_leads}\n\n"
                  f"TARGET LOCATION: {self.location}\n\n"
                  "TASK:\n"
                  "1. GEOGRAPHIC VERIFICATION: If a lead is NOT in {self.location}, mark it as 'REJECTED'.\n"
                  "2. DE-DUPLICATE: Merge unique entries per business.\n"
                  "3. CATEGORIZE:\n"
                  "   - HOT: No website found OR very poor digital presence in {self.location}.\n"
                  "   - WARM: Has a website but it looks old or slow.\n"
                  "   - COLD: Already has a great website.\n"
                  "4. OUTPUT FORMAT:\n"
                  "   Provide a clean table: Business Name | Category | Reasoning | Address\n"
                  "   ONLY list businesses marked as HOT, WARM, or COLD. Skip REJECTED ones.")
        response = llm.invoke(prompt)
        return Message(text=response.content)
